dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and gradual 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and continuous with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; surface is largely uniform with minimal dark-pixel clusters.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between subtle pigment variations and the primary baseline tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of fine, faint linear markings on the mid-dorsal and right-lateral surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Central dorsal ridge presents as a standard longitudinal shadow; no unnatural topological disruptions are visible.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear epidermal scratches, consistent with superficial rake marks, are visible on the dorsal surface.
